entities.summary: Rafaela Alburquerque "Lili" de González, is a Dominican lawyer and diplomat. Since 15 August 2016, she has been a deputy for the province of San Pedro de Macorís for Social Christian Reformist Party. From May 2011 to April 2017, she served as Ambassador of the Dominican Republic to the Chinese Republic of Taiwan; being for 8 months in a duality of public functions that was criticized, because Alburquerque enjoyed two salaries from the State.
